newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH IZOLACJA FIRM PRICES IPO AT PLN 110-140.
newsitem.headline: POLISH IZOLACJA FIRM PRICES IPO AT PLN 110-140.

text.p: Polish insulation materials firm Izolacja SA has priced its December initial public offering at between 110 and 140 zlotys per share, the firm said in an abbreviated version of its issue prospectus.
It said it would provide the final price by December 7.
Izolacja plans to enter the main market of the Warsaw Stock Exchange and would be the first firm from Poland's mass privatisation National Investment Fund (NFI) programme to gain a bourse listing.
The firm is offering investors 100,130 shares from December 9 to December 13, with 70,130 shares needed to be sold for the issue to be valid and investors allowed to register for up to 350 shares.
All of Izolacja's remaining 1,049,870 shares have also been approved for public trade.
The firm's main shareholders are NFI No. 9, which holds 33 percent, and the state treasury, which holds 25.3 percent.
Izolacja, which specialises in making insulation for roofs for residential housing, made a net profit of 8.4 million zlotys last year on sales of 93.1 million zlotys.
It netted 3.1 million zlotys over this year's first half on sales of 41 million zlotys.
